title: Every new car sold in the European Union must include a driver monitoring camera
summary: The European Union has mandated that all new cars sold in the region must include driver monitoring cameras and distraction detection systems, representing a major shift in automotive safety regulations that will take effect for new vehicle types from 2024.
problem_solved: Addresses the growing problem of distracted and drowsy driving, which contributes significantly to road accidents across Europe.
why_valuable: This regulation could substantially reduce traffic fatalities by automatically detecting when drivers are impaired or distracted and alerting them or taking preventive measures.
